headline: Citi takes cautious approach on AI agent access
body: Naveed Anwar, Citi's global head of AI, digital and data platforms within its services business, said at Money20/20: "There are places in which we want to go faster. This is not one of those places."
note: Citi's remark sits alongside the wider bank moves to restrict outside agents, and it is a statement of caution.
